text:
[RFCS.16.1] There is **one** atom registry: a single protobuf `oneof body` over one
field-number space, shared by the DSC container (`Dsc { repeated Atom }`) and the
recorded event trace (`Stream { repeated Atom }`). Each container carries a legal
**subset** of the registry (per [RFCS.17.1]); an atom's field number **is** its wire
identity in both.
